reviewedSemantics: SETKA_IMMUNE_KERNEL_V1 is a bounded extension over the accepted living organism kernel; it does not create a daemon, database, external runtime, canonical store or autonomous destructive worker

IMMUNE_SELF_NONSELF grants SELF_VERIFIED only when declared identity, provenance verification, allowed version and valid authority are all present; authorized external input remains explicitly external and unknown or contradictory evidence does not inherit self privileges

IMMUNE_ANOMALY_TRIAGE computes a declared normalized maximum signal score over values in [0,1] with explicit warning and quarantine thresholds; absent signals fail closed to review and no global damage theorem is inferred from local samples

QUARANTINE_MEMBRANE isolates NONSELF_DECLARED, UNKNOWN_IDENTITY, high-anomaly or review-required candidates before canonical writeback or external effects; quarantine is explicitly isolation rather than deletion and never authorizes history rewrite

AUTOPHAGY_ADMISSION permits only derived mass with verified reconstruction proof, zero active dependencies, no unique irreversible information and retained provenance; canonical causes and unique irreversible inputs are never autophagy eligible

assessAutophagyCandidate produces a reclamation candidate and resource evidence only; it performs no destructive cleanup, authorizes no canonical deletion and routes eligible cleanup through Least Verified Action before any later runtime action
the immune loop is SELF_NONSELF_RECOGNITION -> ANOMALY_TRIAGE -> QUARANTINE_IF_REQUIRED -> REPAIR_OR_AUTOPHAGY_CANDIDATE -> SAFE_CONTROL -> LEAST_VERIFIED_ACTION -> RESOURCE_RECOVERY -> PROVENANCE
